full_judgment: 6. Mr. Abdul Quayum, the learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that, the impugned judgment and order passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division is not supported by any material evidence on record and the same is accordingly liable to be set aside for the ends of Justice. The learned Advocate further submits that the learned Single Judge failed to consider that after 1950 the Zaminder had no right to transfer the land due to the commencement of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
